licence_holder.desc: who holds the provincial electrical contractor licence for this work: bidder, subcontractor or other

licence_number_stated.desc: true if a licence number is written in the proposal

wsib_clearance.desc: true if the proposal confirms current WSIB clearance

liability_insurance_cad.desc: liability insurance coverage amount in CAD

qualifying_installs.desc: number of commercial installs of at least 100 kW completed in the last 5 years (reference year 2026)

install_period.desc: the period for those installs, exactly as written (e.g. a start year)

min_install_kw.desc: smallest system size (kW) the stated installs are described as

price_inclusions.desc: what the stated price explicitly includes (e.g. permits, utility connection)

completion_weeks.desc: committed completion time in weeks from award

named_lead.desc: true if a specific, named project lead or manager is committed (a role to be assigned later is false)

crew_identified.desc: true if the delivery crew is described (e.g. its size or certification)

crew_size.desc: number of crew members, if given

safety_plan.desc: true if a site safety plan is included

monitoring_plan.desc: true if post-installation performance monitoring of the system is offered (progress reporting during construction is not monitoring)

monitoring_months.desc: length of the performance-monitoring period in months

mandatory.label: Provincial electrical contractor licence: the bidder itself holds it and names it in the bid
WSIB clearance and $5M liability insurance, both confirmed

phrases.best: the most qualifying experience of any {eligible}bid ({v} installs)
phrases.missing: no qualifying install count is stated (experience scored 0)
no total price is stated (price scored 0)
phrases.over_limit: the price is above the {limit} budget ceiling (price scored 0)

phrases.missing: no completion time is stated, so the {limit}-week requirement cannot be confirmed (timeline scored 0)
phrases.over_limit: the schedule is longer than {limit} weeks (timeline scored 0)

phrases.best: the longest combined panel and workmanship warranties of any {eligible}bid
phrases.missing: a warranty term is not stated (that part scored 0)

phrases.best: a complete team, safety and monitoring plan
phrases.worst: the least complete team and approach of any {eligible}bid
